explanation: Wardha me Wheat par drought stress ka signal strong hai. Paudhon ko pani kam mil raha hai, isliye light irrigation, mulching aur soil moisture check abhi priority hai.

recommendations.title: Start protective irrigation
recommendations.detail: Give light irrigation in the cooler part of the day and avoid flooding the root zone.

recommendations.title: Reduce soil moisture loss
recommendations.detail: Use mulch or crop residue around plants to slow evaporation from the top soil.

recommendations.title: Check field cracks
recommendations.detail: If cracks are widening, prioritize that plot for water or community irrigation support.

explanation: Purnia me Paddy ke roots zyada paani me suffocate ho sakte hain. Standing water aur yellowing milkar waterlogging stress dikhate hain, drainage jaldi improve karein.

recommendations.title: Open drainage channels
recommendations.detail: Create shallow side channels so extra water can leave the plot within 24 hours.

recommendations.title: Avoid more irrigation
recommendations.detail: Pause irrigation until the top soil starts drying and roots get air again.

recommendations.title: Watch root health
recommendations.detail: Uproot one weak plant and check for black, soft, or foul-smelling roots.

explanation: Kolar me Tomato ke liye fungal disease risk ban raha hai. Humid weather aur spots/powder symptoms saath aaye hain, isliye canopy ko dry rakhna aur infected leaves hatana zaroori hai.

recommendations.title: Improve air movement
recommendations.detail: Remove dense weeds and avoid unnecessary evening irrigation that keeps leaves wet overnight.

recommendations.title: Remove infected leaves
recommendations.detail: Take out heavily infected leaves from the field edge first and keep them away from compost.

recommendations.title: Confirm before spraying
recommendations.detail: Match the spot pattern with a local extension worker before choosing a fungicide.
